motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial needle glides. Candlelight flickers across polished wood. Curtain shadows move softly. Slow theatrical dolly forward.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial sweeps across frequencies. Stage lamps rise from dim to warm. Cabinet highlights bloom. Measured dolly push forward.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial settles. Stage lamps fade to amber. Curtain shadows lengthen. Slow dolly pull back.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial steady, glowing. VU meters pulse gently. Candlelight ripples on wood. Slow orbit around the speaker.
